t.t: Access for residents, staff and contractors
Give access when a resident moves in and revoke it when they move out. Give staff the doors they need, give contractors access for the job, and see which buildings need attention.

div.p: Add the new resident to their site and issue a Wallet key or NFC card. At move-out, revoke it and check that each reader has applied the change; a revocation waiting for an offline reader is not yet in effect there.
Give staff the doors their work needs. Give a contractor access for the job, temporary where supported, and revoke it when the work ends.
Let a local administrator manage access for their building, while you keep one way of working across every site.
Review events and reader status for each site, see changes that are still pending and configure alerts for supported device events.
Add supported cameras and device scenarios where they solve a real need. Check camera models and service scope before you plan them.
Bring these details to the site recommendations or to a conversation with us:

ul.li: Number of sites, and doors at each site
Resident, staff and contractor groups, and the doors each group needs
Existing lock hardware at each door
Wi-Fi or cellular coverage at each door
Who issues and revokes access day to day, and who handles support

t.t: Tell us about the properties you manage
Get recommendations for your sites, or discuss your buildings with our team.
Install, hand over and support access systems
Assess each door, install SmartphoneKey readers, set up the customer's sites and administrators, and support the installation after handover.

li.p: Check door hardware, power, Wi-Fi or cellular coverage at each door, the cards or digital keys the customer wants and any connected devices.
Follow the installation and connection guide for each reader. Choose LTE or Wi-Fi for each door according to coverage and the site's network rules.
Set up the customer's sites, doors and access, and assign their site administrators.
Find the customer's site, review its readers, events and the status of each change, and investigate issues with the customer.

section.h2: Choose the reader for each door

div.p: LTE and Wi-Fi readers work with the same platform. Choose by the connection each door position can support; both need power and compatible lock hardware. Every reader can also act as a Thread Border Router and as a router in the Thread mesh, without a separate firmware version.
div.a: LTE or Wi-Fi: what fits your site?

div.p: The customer's administrators manage their own people, keys and cards. You can be given access to the customer's sites to commission readers and support them after handover; what you can see and do depends on the permissions granted to you.
Discuss distribution, integration, service and branding with our team. What a partnership includes depends on the agreement.
